title: July Property Insights: Support for local housebuilding outweighs opposition, as affordable housing tops consumers' priorities
summary: Jatin Patel, Head of Mortgages, Savings and Insurance at Barclays, analyses the key trends shaping the UK housing market.
body_markdown: Rohan Kumar, Head of Spend Insights at Barclays, looks at what millions of consumer transactions tell us about how Britain spent in July, from rising confidence and summer staycations to blockbuster films, streaming hits and spending boosted by one of the hottest months of the year.
